view_role_contract.default_operation: existing reconstruction inputs retained; same-input candidate photometry may drive a method but is internal fit, not independent accuracy validation
view_role_contract.G_V_scope: optional unused-generation-view diagnostic; quantify input-subset effects separately
view_role_contract.G: depth candidate generation from a frozen training-photo subset
view_role_contract.V: for optional G/V diagnostic only, neighbors excluded from candidate generation/refinement/fusion/joint inference; method inputs, not final evaluation
view_role_contract.T: final evaluation photos excluded from G and V
view_role_contract.existing_same_view_scores: INTERNAL_FIT_DIAGNOSTIC unless source membership proves separation
view_role_contract.independence_limit: reference photo and poses may be shared; not independent sensor or scene validation

scope: Design only; does not replace or enqueue main_v2

method.aggregation: median per-source costs and median paired cost difference stored separately
method.visibility_evidence: independent current-image correspondence; own-source depth or inverse candidate warp does not certify visibility
method.primary_allocation: hard supported winner; baseline ratio on observed agreement
method.source_coefficient: c_s=lambda_s*valid_s/N_s; N_s fixed source-valid target count before evidence gate
method.zero_lambda: never reactivate disabled source; inspect active-source absolute support
method.fallback: prior depth at baseline prior strength; not Gaussian freezing
method.loss: sum of source weighted L1 residuals; no outer mean or weight-sum renormalization

unresolved_before_execution: camera grouping rule and tie break
GT-free threshold candidate grid and selection receipt
candidate-independent correspondence and visibility support implementation

selection_boundary.existing_cases: posthoc explanation layer, not threshold labels
selection_boundary.recipe_revisions: never call reused evaluation independent validation

stages.purpose: photometric technical validation and GT-free recipe freeze
evaluation-only source selection and oracle gap
actual Gaussian gradient and Adam update fork
bounded optimization comparison; resources/steps to bind after G4
separate source, protection, controller, repeat and independent validation
